final_message:
Fixed: "Crème brûlée recipes" now gives `creme-brulee-recipes`, and `npm test` passes (3/3).

The vendored slugify strips every non-ASCII letter, so the accents were disappearing along with their letters. I left `vendor/` alone, as you said. The change is in `src/blog/slug.js`. `postSlug` now decomposes the title (`normalize('NFD')`) and drops the combining accent marks before it calls slugify.

`src/shop/product-url.js` also mentions slugs. I didn't check whether it has the same problem, since you only asked about blog posts.
